title: No test: client disconnects while recv() blocks
description: The commit introduces live_tx.closed() to unblock rx.recv() when the client disconnects mid-stream. There is no test exercising this path: a live SSE connection held open, client drops (live_rx dropped), no broadcast in flight, task must exit. All existing tests use closeafter=state and terminate via take(N), so they never exercise the closed() branch. The fix is correct but untested — a future regression would be silent.
